core_obligations: By Lemma \reflemma-faithful the functor is faithful. Let U_1 \to S and U_2 \to S be \'etale morphisms and let a : X \times_S U_1 \to X \times_S U_2 be a morphism compatible with canonical descent data.
Let U'_2 \subset U_2 be an open subscheme. Consider W = a^-1(X \times_S U'_2).
Let U_2 = \bigcup U_2, i be an affine open covering. By the result of the preceding paragraph we obtain an open covering U_1 = \bigcup U_1, i such that X \times_S U_1, i = a^-1(X \times_S U_2, i).

Assume U_2 \to S is separated. Then the graph \Gamma_a of a is a closed subscheme of V = (X \times_S U_1) \times_X (X \times_S U_2) = X \times_S U_1 \times_S U_2 by Schemes, Lemma \refschemes-lemma-semi-diagonal.
proof_roadmap: 第 1 步：By Lemma \reflemma-faithful the functor is faithful. Let U_1 \to S and U_2 \to S be \'etale morphisms and let a : X \times_S U_1 \to X \times_S U_2 be a morphism compatible with canonical descent data.
第 2 步：Let U'_2 \subset U_2 be an open subscheme. Consider W = a^-1(X \times_S U'_2).

第 3 步：Let U_2 = \bigcup U_2, i be an affine open covering. By the result of the preceding paragraph we obtain an open covering U_1 = \bigcup U_1, i such that X \times_S U_1, i = a^-1(X \times_S U_2, i).

第 4 步：Assume U_2 \to S is separated. Then the graph \Gamma_a of a is a closed subscheme of V = (X \times_S U_1) \times_X (X \times_S U_2) = X \times_S U_1 \times_S U_2 by Schemes, Lemma \refschemes-lemma-semi-diagonal.
items.difficulty_reason: H2: the counted author proof descends compatible open subsets using the etale-stable quotient topology, localizes the target to an affine separated etale scheme, and descends an open-and-closed graph. Its graph projection is recovered as a universally bijective etale map, so compatible morphisms descend without a flatness or connected-fibre assumption. The nonroutine part is constructing the descended graph from topological saturation and gluing; it is included in the own full proof2067-2121. This is not merely the categorical definition of full faithfulness or an application of fpqc descent.

items.original_difficulty_reason: 平展下降函子的完全忠实性：作者自建由图与开集的相容推出态射来自底上态射的论证。先由忠实性得忠实，随后自建：对带下降数据的态射与任一开子集取其原像，用降数据相容与基变换的满射性说明该原像是底上某子集的原像，再用假设（子mersive 与其 etale 基变换仍子mersive）得该子集开，沿此构造出图；末段用平展射的开图定理把图认成态射的像并核对基变换。用图与原像的相容性造出底上态射是本条的实质。
